name: Kärnebygd - Ätran
description: Kärnebygd to Ätran. Candidate import from normalized research; verify current notices before publication.
utilities: Hyr båt eller kanot i Eseredssjön (transit)
waterSources: Dricksvatten Ätran / year-round toilet: Official drinking-water and year-round toilet point in Ätran. Official section text says to fill water in Ätran because there is no water at the campsites.
notes: Swedish official page/API/GPX and Naturkartan title use Kärnebygd - Ätran. English page still titles the section Kvarnlyckan - Ätran and menu says previous section Ullared - Kvarnlyckan.
Multiple secondary/current platforms still use Kärnebygd - Eseredssjön while the official Swedish page now uses Kärnebygd - Ätran.
Official GPX/API geo_json computes 10.984 km and official display is 11 km. Naturkartan displays 12.0 km; API line.geometry computes 12.3 km; OSM relation computes about 12.347 km.

The places API returned 20 records only when queried with the page form parameters including output-template=trails.placeItem and offset. Simpler output=json calls used by the coordinator initially returned zero.
Swedish page says Svårighetsgradering Blå and API value is medium. English heading says Degree of difficulty Blue/Red.

Some facility context suggests shelter/fireplace/firewood; Visit Fegen says firewood is not available at Eseredssjön and visitors should bring their own. Waste-bin status was only indirectly suggested from adjacent context.

facilities.name: Kärnebygds kvarn och såg
facilities.description: Cultural site at Kärnebygd. Official text says the mill was built in the early 1700s and the saw around 1830; Skogssällskapet confirms visitor/cultural context. Could be merged/displayed with nearby Rastplats Kärnebygds såg depending POI granularity.

facilities.name: Rastplats Kärnebygds såg
facilities.description: Official rest-place point near Kärnebygds saw/mill. Nearby to the cultural POI; avoid duplicate clutter if app clusters rest/POI records.

facilities.name: Lägerplats Kärnebygd / Kärnebygds vindskydd
facilities.description: Official shelter/campsite at Kärnebygd. Shelter for 4-6 adults in Hallandsleden text and 4-5 people in Falkenberg/Naturkartan context; fireplace and dry toilet. Kärnebygd shelter is in open/grazing landscape with livestock often nearby. About 0.8 km from current M3 GPX line; likely served by old/stale line.geometry. OSM/Vindskyddskartan name Vindskydd Hagaberg is probably the same cluster, not a second shelter. No potable water verified.

facilities.name: Gunnarps marknad
facilities.description: Site of Halland's oldest rural market with medieval origins; official text says the last market was held in 1953.

facilities.name: Gunnarps kyrka
facilities.description: Gunnarp church, described by the official page as one of very few wooden churches in Halland. No public toilet/water service verified for hikers.

facilities.name: Milsten vid Gunnarp
facilities.description: 1846 milestone along the old road between Gällared and Gunnarp.
